name: tier-separable-tests
body: Tests are organized so each tier can be selected independently and the default gate stays fast. Unit and int tests live beside their module in a sibling `tests.rs` that preserves the module path, so libtest's `…::tests::unit::` and `…::tests::int::` filters keep selecting them; every e2e test lives outside the production module tree in a top-level `tests/` integration crate and carries the `#[ignore = "e2e tier: …; run via cargo test-e2e"]` marker. A plain `cargo test` runs unit+int only; `cargo test-e2e` runs the e2e tier. The four documented invocations keep selecting the tiers they name.
